headline: Chile's Budget Office Estimates Fuel Price Relief Bill to Cost $813 Million
summary: Chile's fiscal budget office estimates a proposed government bill capping fuel costs and relieving transport hauliers will cost $813 million through 2028, depending on global crude volatility.
why: Chile is a net importer of energy products, making domestic fuel subsidies significant drivers of national budget spending.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Fuel subsidy spending increases public expenditure liabilities through 2028.
